name: CO2 near the critical point: potential-based vs direct surrogate
description: Networks trained on the same mixed CoolProp data of CO2 (each sample carries one of p, s, u, c_v, c_p, w): a Helmholtz-energy network whose properties are its derivatives (MLP and input-convex variants) against one output per property, same loss, optimiser and steps; errors inside the training region and in two extrapolation regions, and the thermodynamic identities. One seed at a reduced budget; examples/potential_co2/01_run_study.py runs five seeds and three configurations.
